newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf oil engineer killed in Nigeria ambush.
newsitem.headline: Elf oil engineer killed in Nigeria ambush.

text.p: An engineer for French oil group Elf Aquitaine was shot and killed in an ambush by gunmen in Nigeria on Thursday, the company said on Friday.

"He was returning from work in the car of a colleague," an Elf spokeswoman said. "They were stopped by bandits and he was shot with a sub-machine gun. He died immediately. The colleague managed to escape."
Elf Aquitaine declined to identify the man, who leaves a wife and children in France. "It is the first time that our company has lost a colleague in such a tragic way," the spokeswoman said.
Elf regards Nigeria as a "difficult" country but the spokeswoman said there were no plans to abandon activities there.
